question: Danda-nacha is a form of dance that narrates stories about:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Shiva.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Danda-nacha is a form of dance that narrates stories about Lord Shiva.**
 
• Danda-nacha:
 
 
• ​It's one of the oldest dances of India performed in** Odisha.**
 
• Narrates the story of **Shiva with social harmony and brotherhood.​**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other dance forms of Lord Shiva:**

 
 
• **Manipuri:**

 
 
• It is the celestial dance of **shiva and Parvati in Manipur.**
 
• Manipuri origin is from the festival of **Lai Haraoba.**
 
 
 
• **​Gangor Dance:**
 
 
• It is mainly popular among the borders of Rajasthan state.
 
• The dance is performed for hours by the women.
 
• The dancing pattern changes in accordance with the music and the smile are considered the most important element of this performance.
 
• On some occasions in Haryana, the Gangor dance usually takes the form of Kirtan dedicated to God.
 
• It is usually performed in the months of Phalgun and Chaitra.
 
• This dance is strictly dedicated to Lord Shiva and his wife Gangor (Goddess Parvati).
 
• It is performed during the Puja ceremony to impress the God and Goddess held to worship for a Rich Harvest the following years.
